papers.title: WearableQA: A Benchmark for Health Reasoning over Real-World Wearable Data
papers.what: Builds 4,084 ten-option questions from the real 500-day wearable records, blood biomarkers and demographics of 200 people, keeping device noise and between-person variability, and splits them along data-versus-health and single-versus-cross-signal axes so a score says where a model failed rather than only how often; 14 models span 19.6 to 72.9 percent against a 10 percent floor.
papers.builds_on: LLMs are Few-Shot Health Learners (2023, JX3X3KH5); Health-LLM (2024, 7RHTW5L3); GLOBEM (2023, ICD9EG8Q)

papers.title: HealthLoopQA: Context-Aware QA for Wearable Monitoring in Diabetes Care
papers.what: Replaces the collected dataset with a simulated hybrid closed-loop insulin testbed so that causal questions have ground-truth answers and 17 device-failure and security-fault scenarios can be injected on demand, then grades questions by reasoning depth and scores numerical accuracy separately from the paired textual rationale.
papers.builds_on: Verifiable Physiological Reasoning (2026, 2BGP9QJL); Health-LLM (2024, 7RHTW5L3); TS-Agent (2025, I2CIT4I7)

papers.title: Revisiting Complete Reasoning Traces for Post-Training
papers.authors: Hwang, Yun, Heo, Han (NAVER AI Lab)
papers.what: Deletes the middle of reasoning trajectories used for supervised fine-tuning and finds that heavy truncation costs little, with attention analysis and controlled token-removal indicating that intermediate tokens contribute minimally because a model given the endpoints can reconstruct coherent steps from internal knowledge.
papers.builds_on: Chain-of-Thought (2023, HBLPTRMY); DeepSeek-R1 (2025, Z5IWHZAE); CODI (2025, FFWLYL3J)

papers.title: Co-Evolving Harnesses and Models: On-Policy Correction Helps Weaker Models Catch Up Where Imitation Fails
papers.what: Shows that fine-tuning a weak model on a strong expert's full trajectories under a harness already evolved for that weak model regresses on all seven enterprise tasks by 4 to 30 points, because imitation installs a planning style the harness was not shaped around, and fixes it by having a meta-level agent localize the failing turn in the model's own rollout and rewrite only that turn.
